text: What are these weird marker things?
reply: That is a heading marker: an invisible point the game uses to tell people where to stand, face or walk (this one is linked to a second marker by the road, so it marks a route), carried over from the source place. Nobody sees it in the game, so I left it as it is; delete it in the studio if you want it gone.

text: I cant change the heights of doors for some reason, like their vertical position
reply: This is a fault in the studio, not in the place: the hut's door is set to sit on the hut, and when you let go of a raise or lower the studio puts it back at the hut's height (the same happens to anything seated on another thing). I changed nothing here; the fix is a small change to the studio's move tool, which I have passed on to be made.

text: I need a way to rotate pieces in all axes - i.e. I can't currently tilt this plank down to join this bit of the ship to the dock. I want the ship and dock in this position I've moved them to, with the plank basically here but tilted so its top edge sits on the deck of the ship at this location and its lower edge sits on the deck of the dock.
reply: Select the plank on its own (turn on Pieces, or tap it a second time inside its unit), then use Tilt forward, Tilt back, Roll left or Roll right in "Move a little", or type exact Tilt, Roll and Turn degrees. The plank at the landing is now tilted from the ship's deck to the dock: its lower end rests on the jetty's deck and its upper end on the barge's front deck, each within 3 cm, and the barge and the jetty stay exactly where you put them.

text: the walking routes - i think the ones going on and off the ship will be buggy. lets' not do those. people on the ship should just stay on the ship, and people on th eland stay on land. update them.
reply: Done. Nobody's daily routine crosses between the barge and the land any more. The barge's people stay aboard: Okeeh the cook now sleeps in the barge's hold, in the bed Mee-shei used, as well as cooking there, and Hara-Jeel spends his morning on the barge's deck. The land people stay ashore: Mee-shei, whose daytime you had put on land, now sleeps in the camp in the bed Okeeh left, and all of Xil-neeus's spots are on land at the landing. The boarding plank is still there for you to walk on. Quest 1 still works: Okeeh meets the new gang in the hold, and Dralin now waits for them at the land end of the jetty instead of on the barge.

text: people's routine routes should not go through buildings or tents, should go round, and should gebnerally prioritise paths. also i want to be able to draw the routes in the studio if i choose
reply: People's lines now go round houses and tents and prefer the paths. To make someone take a particular way, open their stop in People, press "Draw the way here", tap along the way and press Done. In the game the person walks the drawn way marker by marker on the way to that stop. At Ashgate Landing nobody's way needed drawing: the barge's people stay aboard, the camp's people keep to the land, and every line runs on the walking ground round the tents.

text: i don't seem to be able to easily snap torch scones or other wall attach type things to walls. and light sources like torches don't seem to come with lights?
reply: Choose a sconce, holder, shelf, sign or banner in Add things and tap a wall: it goes flat on the wall's surface, facing out; an existing one has a "Hang on a wall" button. Anything that gives light now comes with its light when added or duplicated, and the light moves and goes with it. Your torch had none because only duplicates copied lights before. The torch you added by the hut now has its light.
